exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "That is to say".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～っていう matches "That is to say".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～っていう.
exercises.explanation: Used to quote, define, or specify nouns; means "called" or "that is to say."
